We’ll need 2 types of assets for each spirit a sprite and a 3d model. This will allow us to test our pipeline. Before we do that we need to figure out what a spirit looks and feels like. I think exploring the combinatorial between nation element daemon and some cross section of animal monster morphology is what’s wanting to emerge but it remains to be clear.
